WITH written AS (
    UPDATE contracts_node n
    SET props = CASE WHEN n.props ->> 'p4' IS NULL THEN n.props - '__drivine.lower.p4'
                     ELSE n.props || jsonb_build_object('__drivine.lower.p4', lower(n.props ->> 'p4')) END
    WHERE n.nid IN (
        SELECT m.nid FROM contracts_node m
        WHERE m.labels @> '["CiLate"]' AND (m.props ->> '__drivine.lower.p4') IS DISTINCT FROM lower((m.props ->> 'p4'))
        LIMIT CAST($batch AS int))
    RETURNING 1)
SELECT count(*) FROM written
